Ben and Tom had great fun there. Life is full of small surprises. Ben hopes to visit London one day. Best of all, it might snow tonight, so wear warm clothes.
Ben bought a hat at the shop yesterday. Ben drinks milk after doing sports. Ben is reading a book about science. The whole family assembled in the kitchen for dinner.
The school lab is one of the best places in the city. Ben learned a lot about science. They took many photos at the robot show.
